# Escaping the planet Escaping the planet is the [color=gold][bold]primary win condition[/bold][/color] of this event. To escape, you must construct the [color=cyan]Wormhole Generator[/color], a device that facilitates your escape from the planet.
## Construction To build the Wormhole Generator, you must obtain [color=cyan]four unique components[/color]. It's strongly recommended to organise competent expeditionary teams to find these artifacts.
Once you have obtained these parts, you can begin building the Wormhole Generator using the construction menu. It's under the Objective tab, or just search for the name. You should build it somewhere defensible, ideally in the heart of your base of operations. It cannot be moved once built, and you cannot reverse the construction steps.
## Activation Once constructed, the wormhole generator can be activated. This is an irreversible decision, and takes 20 minutes to complete. During this time, [color=red][bold]raids will escalate dramatically![/bold][/color]
You should be [bold]very, very sure[/bold] when you activate the wormhole generator. There's no going back once you do, and it will be your final challenge on the planet. Prepare carefully and fortify your base, and remember, not everyone will make it home. Sacrifices are inevitable.
To activate the wormhole generator, you must have Command access on your ID card. When you want it to happen, ahelp, since there is no mechanical way for it to happen.
